title: W1 IDENTIFIER APPLICATION BINDING

implementationResponsibilities.capture: producer / initial prospective allocator implementation location

directionEvidence.standing: approves finalisation direction, NOT this exact publication

statusRule: Controlled specification on competent Owner-authorised verified publication; candidate before that event
effectivityRule: Effective for W1 DEVELOPMENT / CONFORMANCE at the verified Owner-authorised atomic publication revision; no invented date or containing hash
operationalApplicability: NOT established by publication; exact real format, issuer/allocator, principal/grant, policy and deployment applicability required before corresponding real use
implementationAuthorisation: NONE conveyed by this specification or its publication
governingProfile: ADR-AMHARC-006, Canonical Match Occurrence Identifier Profile v1 (already Accepted/Effective)

canonicalAllocation.allowedMechanisms: .NET 8 Guid.NewGuid with explicit lower-case D serialization for the bounded Capture allocator; any separately applicable Node allocator uses node:crypto.randomUUID, never browser/global fallback.
canonicalAllocation.idempotencyScope: exact appointed allocator/issuer namespace + stable durable logical creation operation key
canonicalAllocation.atomicity: one durable creation result and one occurrence per logical creation; retry returns same result; collision allocates another unused UUID within same logical operation
canonicalAllocation.nonReuse: never reissue retired/deleted occurrence ID; retain necessary/permissible allocation tombstone and decision history
canonicalAllocation.acknowledgement: creation result / allocation ledger / material activity atomically recoverable before durable success acknowledgement

namespaces.capture: PROPOSED namespace urn:amharc:representation:capture; installation/issuer qualification required
namespaces.tagger: PROPOSED namespace urn:amharc:representation:tagger; installation/issuer qualification required
namespaces.standing: candidate names, not registered issuer appointments

resolution.change: new attributable resolution revision; no rewrite of prior denotation
resolution.prohibited: automatic retrospective reconciliation; existing GUID/UUID primary keys remain unchanged

allocatorApplicability: Capture is initial implementation LOCATION, not universal identity/semantic/acceptance authority. Generic verification/allocation mechanism requires no real installation appointment; operational allocation requires its exact governed issuer/allocator context.
issuerNamespaceModel: Externally governed installation-qualified issuer identity. Suggested namespace family urn:amharc:issuer:capture:<installation-id> is a template, NOT a real appointment; distinguish Tagger issuer scope. Never bake fixture identifiers into authority.
